Memorable watch cheers for the early crew
A month with welfare walks in mind
Steady paws, steady plans

This round at the Companion Animal Travel Desk has kept the team focused on calm handling, careful checks, and clear handoffs for every journey. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey. The desk welcomes questions in a warm professional tone, and travelers have responded well to the patient guidance from the team. We are also grateful for the cabin team, who monitors animals during flight with close attention and steady care.

Aurelia Skyways continues to see how small details protect comfort for pets and owners alike. When Moose or any other companion is booked for travel, the path is smoother when papers are complete and the carrier is ready. Please keep up the clean records, the kind tone, and the careful eye on each case. Companion Animal Travel Desk
